book.notCommittedBecause: Global Grey ebooks edition (Calibre); the text is public domain but this packaging is not clearly free to redistribute. Keep a local copy with this SHA-256 to run tests that need it.
book.edition: Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland — Global Grey ebooks, Calibre-made MOBI
book.structure: MOBI file version 6, no KF8 section (no BOUNDARY record, no EXTH 121); UTF-8, PalmDOC compression, 207,818 text bytes. Compiled NCX (INDX): 12 entries, fileposes 6177, 19395, 32829, 53320, 70168, 87207, 105712, 123504, 141081, 158449, 175023, 189332 (chapters 1-12). Front matter (title, contents) precedes the first entry.

device: Samsung Galaxy S25 (SM-S931B), Android 17, 1080x2340; Moon+ Reader Pro 10.8, automatic Drive sync
display: The user's Moon+ settings (font serif 18.0, line spacing 3, left/right margins 10, top 20, bottom 16), portrait 1080x2340, Moon+'s light day theme.
notes: Same .po grammar and offsets as EPUB: {chapter}@{split}#{offset}, offset in rendered characters, not bytes (the text has many 3-byte curly quotes and dashes, yet probes are within 2-4 characters of a naive character count).

Chapter 0 is the front matter before the first NCX entry (Moon+ lists it under the book title), so Moon+ chapter n = NCX entry n-1: chapter 1 starts at filepos 6177 ('1. Down The Rabbit-Hole'). readsync's resolve_mobi_chapter_filepos uses fileposes[chapter] and would land one chapter late on this book.

Chapter text starts at the heading: 'Down The Rabbit-Hole' at 3 (after '1. '), the first paragraph at 24. A naive tag-strip from filepos 6177 gives 26 / 246 for A2 / A3 (Moon+ 24 / 244: the ' ' line after the heading is not in Moon+'s text) and 3536 / 4033 for A4 / A5 (Moon+ 3532 / 4029).
